card.name: Words before swallowing or absorption instructions
card.fires_on: The small word 'to' or 'cannot' right after 'unable' or 'patients who', just before 'swallow' a tablet or capsule. Also 'improve' or 'increase' after 'with food to', before 'absorption'.

modes.label: Unable to swallow
